integrity: The signed multiplier and projection-kernel histograms are independently reproduced using exact integer Walsh butterflies and signed-height transfer recurrences. Both Parseval identities and all certificate bytes are checked.
scientific_limitations: Full Fourier spectrum and projection norm are exhaustively established only for length ten; no all-length classification or independent validation is claimed. Small-length invertibility is established through length nine.
title: The first post-cubic Walsh resonance and exact Fourier range projection for length-ten Motzkin paths
